setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern, C3 D3 E3 F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, through the test MIDI device at 90 BPM with Rate /1 and channel range steps 1-4. The sequencer is stopped. Channel 1 has been made slow: its range is steps 1-3 and Clock Mod is /9, so one step lasts 1.5 seconds and the phrase 60, 62, 64 cycles every 4.5 seconds. Song mode is On and the song has two 64-step slots, 10.7 seconds each. Slot 2 is a copy of slot 1 with the channel octave raised by one, so it sounds an octave higher: C4 D4 E4 are 72, 74, 76. Slot 1 is selected, so on the Song editor (grid (6,8)) its LED (1,1) is bright and (2,1) dim. Both reset options are Off.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Play. After 10.7 seconds, at the 64-step slot change, the slot LEDs swap brightness: (2,1) is now the bright one.
steps.title: Watch the slot change

steps.caption: Let it play to 23 seconds, then stop. The phrase keeps its place across the slot change: slot 2 starts on E4 (76) at 12 seconds, not C4. Read the note times in the MIDI strip.
steps.title: Both resets off: the phase carries across two slots

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Reset on song seq change and turn E3 right to On; Reset on pattern repeat stays Off. Close the menu and play 23 seconds. At each slot change, 10.7 and 21.3 seconds, the channel restarts on its first step: C4 (72) sounds exactly at the change, an octave above slot 1's C3, and the slot LEDs swap as before.
steps.title: Restart at a changed song slot
